<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="tmRKVhhmhcovpxCD--bL" name="Class-Diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="3844" dy="1342" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

class Ids <<Utility>> {
 - Ids()
 + {static} next(prefix: String): String
}

class User {
 - id: String
 - username: String
 - hashPassword: String
 - role: String
 - email: String
 - info: Customer
 - avatarUrl: String
 - createdAt: LocalDateTime
 - updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 - cart: Cart
 - loyaltyTransactions: List<LoyaltyTransaction>
 - barista: Barista
 - phone: String
 - fullName: String
 - position: String
 # onCreate(): void
 # onUpdate(): void
}

class Customer {
 - id: String
 - user: User
 - name: String
 - dateOfBirth: LocalDate
 - gender: boolean
 - address: String
 - phone: String
 - orders: List<Order>
 - assignId(): void
}

class Barista {
 - id: String
 - name: String
 - inventoryTransactions: List<InventoryTransaction>
 - assignId(): void
}

class Cart {
 - id: String
 - user: User
 - items: List<CartItem>
 - assignId(): void
 + addItem(item: CartItem): void
 + removeItem(item: CartItem): void
 + clearCart(): void
 + getTotalPrice(): long
}

class CartItem {
 - id: String
 - cart: Cart
 - product: Product
 - quantity: int
 - assignId(): void
 + getSubtotal(): long
}

class Category {
 - id: String
 - name: String
 - slug: String
 - description: String
 - products: List<Product>
 - isActive: boolean
 - assignId(): void
}

class Product {
 - id: String
 - name: String
 - price: long
 - description: String
 - imageUrl: String
 - status: boolean
 - rating: Double
 - weeklySalesCount: Integer
 - category: Category
 - assignId(): void
 + activate(): void
 + deactivate(): void
 + changePrice(newPrice: long): void
}

class Topping {
 - id: String
 - name: String
 - price: long
 - isAvailable: boolean
 - orderItemToppings: List<OrderItemTopping>
 - assignId(): void
}

class Order {
 - id: String
 - customer: Customer
 - totalAmount: long
 - discount: Promotion
 - finalAmount: long
 - status: OrderStatus
 - createdAt: LocalDateTime
 - items: List<OrderItem>
 - processes: List<OrderProcess>
 - assignId(): void
 + changeStatus(newStatus: OrderStatus): void
 - recordProcess(newStatus: OrderStatus): void
}

class OrderItem {
 - id: String
 - order: Order
 - product: Product
 - quantity: long
 - unitPrice: long
 - note: String
 - size: String
 - sugarPercent: Integer
 - icePercent: Integer
 - toppings: List<String>
 - orderItemToppings: List<OrderItemTopping>
 - assignId(): void
 + calculateSubtotal(): long
}

class OrderItemTopping {
 - id: String
 - orderItem: OrderItem
 - topping: Topping
 - quantity: int
 - price: long
 - assignId(): void
}

class OrderProcess {
 - id: String
 - order: Order
 - status: OrderStatus
 - updateAt: LocalDateTime
 - assignId(): void
}

class Promotion {
 - id: String
 - voucherCode: String
 - description: String
 - discountType: DiscountType
 - discountValue: long
 - startDate: LocalDate
 - endDate: LocalDate
 - usageLimit: long
 - usedCount: long
 - isActive: boolean
 - orders: List<Order>
 - assignId(): void
 + isValid(): boolean
 + calculateDiscount(totalAmount: long): long
}

class Payment {
 - id: String
 - order: Order
 - totalAmount: long
 - paymentMethod: PaymentMethod
 - paymentStatus: PaymentStatus
 - paymentDate: LocalDateTime
 - assignId(): void
}

class Invoice {
 - id: String
 - invoiceNumber: String
 - order: Order
 - totalPaid: long
 - issuedDate: LocalDateTime
}

class Invoices {
 - id: String
 - invoiceNumber: String
 - order: Order
 - totalPaid: long
 - issuedDate: LocalDateTime
 - assignId(): void
}

class LoyaltyTransaction {
 - id: String
 - user: User
 - order: Order
 - transactionType: LoyalType
 - points: int
 - balancedAfter: int
 - description: String
 - createDate: LocalDate
 - assignId(): void
}

class Inventory {
 - id: String
 - items: List<Ingredient>
 - assignId(): void
}

class Ingredient {
 - id: String
 - name: String
 - unit: UnitType
 - currentStock: int
 - minAlertThreshold: double
 - inventory: Inventory
 - assignId(): void
}

class InventoryTransaction {
 - id: String
 - type: InventoryTransactionType
 - createAt: LocalDateTime
 - note: String
 - barista: Barista
 - details: InventoryTransactionDetails
 - assignId(): void
}

class InventoryTransactionDetails {
 - id: String
 - inventoryTransaction: InventoryTransaction
 - ingredient: Ingredient
 - quantity: double
 - price: long
 - assignId(): void
}

enum DiscountType {
 PERCENTAGE
 FIX_AMOUNT
}

enum InventoryTransactionType {
 IMPORT
 EXPORT
 ADJUSTMENT
}

enum LoyalType {
 EARN
 REDEEM
 ADJUSTMENT
 EXPIRE
}

enum OrderStatus {
 PENDING
 CONFIRMED
 PREPARING
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
 + canTransitionTo(next: OrderStatus): boolean
}

enum PaymentMethod {
 MOMO
 VIETQR
}

enum PaymentStatus {
 PENDING
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
 CANCELLED
 EXPIRED
}

enum UnitType {
 PACK
 CAN
 BOX
 PIECE
}

User \"1\" <--> \"0..1\" Customer : has
User \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Barista : is
User \"1\" *--> \"0..1\" Cart : owns
User \"1\" *--> \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : owns

Customer \"1\" <--> \"0..*\" Order : places

Cart \"1\" *--> \"0..*\" CartItem : contains
CartItem \"0..*\" --> \"1\" Product : references
Category \"1\" *--> \"0..*\" Product : contains

Order \"1\" *--> \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains
Order \"1\" *--> \"1..*\" OrderProcess : tracks
Order \"0..*\" <--> \"0..1\" Promotion : applies
Order \"1\" <-- \"0..1\" Payment : processed_by
Order \"1\" <-- \"0..1\" Invoice : billed_in
Order \"1\" <-- \"0..1\" Invoices : billed_in
Order \"0..1\" <-- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : generates

OrderItem \"0..*\" --> \"1\" Product : references
OrderItem \"1\" *--> \"0..*\" OrderItemTopping : has
OrderItemTopping \"0..*\" <--> \"1\" Topping : references

Barista \"1\" <--> \"0..*\" InventoryTransaction : performs
InventoryTransaction \"1\" *--> \"1\" InventoryTransactionDetails : details
InventoryTransactionDetails \"0..*\" --> \"1\" Ingredient : references
Inventory \"1\" *--> \"0..*\" Ingredient : contains

Order ..> OrderStatus
OrderProcess ..> OrderStatus
Promotion ..> DiscountType
Payment ..> PaymentMethod
Payment ..> PaymentStatus
LoyaltyTransaction ..> LoyalType
InventoryTransaction ..> InventoryTransactionType
Ingredient ..> UnitType
